name: How long does a full pool renovation take in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How many weeks does a typical pool renovation take in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: How many weeks does a typical pool renovation take in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline depends on how much of the pool is being rebuilt versus refreshed. A simple resurfacing can move quickly once materials are ordered and the pool is drained, but a fuller renovation usually includes demolition, shell prep, surface application, curing time, equipment installation, and final startup. In Los Angeles, the schedule often stretches when inspections are needed, specialty finishes have long lead times, or older pools reveal cracks, leak issues, or outdated plumbing. Access also matters; tight side yards, hillside lots, and limited staging space can slow work. Homeowners should ask for a milestone-based schedule that shows when demolition begins, when inspections occur, and when the pool can be refilled and balanced. The best way to avoid disappointment is to plan for a range rather than a single date, especially if the project is happening during peak season. A realistic schedule is often more useful than an aggressive promise.
acceptedAnswer.description: A surface-only pool renovation can take about one to two weeks, while a full renovation with replastering, tile, coping, and equipment updates often takes three to six weeks or longer. Permits, inspection timing, weather, and hidden repairs can extend the schedule.
